transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having pain in my lower back that's been bothering me. It came on out of nowhere about a month ago.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
No, I don't have any allergies to medicines that I know of.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain at all and 10 is the worst pain you can imagine, how would you rate your lower back pain these days?
It's about a 6 out of 10. It's worst first thing in the morning.
Could you tell me about any medicines you are taking at the moment?
I take gliclazide 80 mg twice a day and metformin 1 g twice a day for my diabetes. And since the back pain started, I've been taking ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day that I got from the chemist.
Besides the back pain, have you noticed any other symptoms or changes in how you feel?
No, I haven't had any fever or weight loss, and no numbness or trouble with my waterworks or bowels. But I can't do any gardening now and I need help putting my socks on.
What kinds of things, if any, seem to make your back pain better or worse?
Bending and getting out of the car make it worse. It eases off when I lie on my side or use a hot water bottle.
Other than your diabetes, is there anything else about your past health — like other ongoing conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays — that you’d like to tell me about?
I had a similar episode of back pain about 5 years ago, but it settled with physiotherapy. Nothing else I can think of.
What worries you most about your back pain?
I want to know whether I've slipped a disc, and whether I need to have a scan.
What does the pain in your lower back feel like?
It's a stiff, aching pain, with the odd sharp twinge.
Besides the gliclazide, metformin, and ibuprofen you mentioned, is there anything else you take or have recently taken?
No, that's everything I take.
Is there anything else you've noticed or want to mention that we haven't talked about yet?
No, I don't think there's anything else.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
